chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ḥasanī, may Allah have mercy on him, and ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿAbd Allāh, both from Ibrāhīm ibn Isḥāq al-Aḥmar, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn ʿAbd Allāh al-Khuzāʿī, from Naṣr ibn Muzāḥim, from ʿAmr ibn Shimr, from Jābir, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

When the daughter of Yazdajird was brought before ʿUmar, the young women of al-Madīnah looked on at her, and the mosque was illuminated by her radiance when she entered it. When ʿUmar looked at her, she covered her face and said: “Uff! Bīrūj bādā Hurmuz.” So ʿUmar said: “Is she insulting me?” and he moved against her. Then Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said to him: “That is not for you. Let her choose a man from among the Muslims, and reckon her as part of his share from the fayʾ.”

So he gave her the choice, and she came forward until she placed her hand on the head of al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام. Amīr al-Muʾminīn said to her: “What is your name?” She said: “Jahān Shāh.” Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said to her: “Rather, Shahrbānūyah.” Then he said to al-Ḥusayn: “O Abā ʿAbd Allāh, there shall be born to you from her the best of the people of the earth.” So she gave birth to ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, and ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام used to be called: “The son of the two chosen ones,” for Allah’s chosen one from the Arabs was Hāshim, and from the non-Arabs was Fāris.
And it is narrated that Abū al-Aswad al-Duʾalī said concerning him: “Indeed, a young man between Kisrā and Hāshim is surely the noblest of those upon whom amulets have been hung.”

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: title of Imām ʿAlī عليه السلام in the narration
key_terms.ابْنُ الْخِيَرَتَيْنِ: an epithet for ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام meaning the son of the two chosen lineages
key_terms.الْمُسْلِمِينَ: the Muslim community from whom she was told to choose a husband
key_terms.بِفَيْئِهِ: as part of his allotted share from the fayʾ
key_terms.بِنْتُ يَزْدَجَرْدَ: the daughter of Yazdajird, identified in the report as the Persian princess brought to al-Madīnah
key_terms.شَهْرَبَانُوَيْهِ: the name given to her in the narration by Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام
key_terms.فَارِسُ: Persia, mentioned as the chosen lineage among the non-Arabs in this report
key_terms.هَاشِمٌ: the chosen lineage among the Arabs mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: How does al-Kāfī describe the marriage of the daughter of Yazdajird to Imām al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام and the lineage of Imām ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This narration recounts the arrival of the daughter of Yazdajird and her marriage to al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام by her own selection, under the direction of Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام. It also highlights the noble lineage of Imām ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, describing him as descended from the chosen ones of both the Arabs and the non-Arabs.
